title: The French Opera, languages and band concerts
summary: Picou loved the French Opera near his boyhood home, discusses French and Spanish, band concerts, and playing in the opera orchestra.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything about the real French Opera? Did you ever go to the French Opera when you were a boy and see the opera? I used to be crazy about the French Opera. I used to love, not like, love the eggs. The French. Oh, yeah, because my father, Frenchman. Yes. Oh, no. I used to live right one block from the French Opera. On St. Peter? St. Peter? Boybock. St. Peter? Boybock. Yes. One block I had to walk. And I had to go that high step, you know? Fifteen cents. Oh, yeah, that's fifteen cents up in the balcony. Yeah. You know I ain't lying. No, I'm sorry. No, I'm sorry. Yes, sir. What? I love French. That's a language I love and Spanish. I love them two languages. Do you speak Spanish too?
Spanish? Do you speak Spanish too?
Yeah. Oh. Do you speak Spanish?
Yes. Oh. Do you speak Spanish? Bastante? Yes. Bastante? Yes. Mucho gracias, señor. That means a little bit. Speak a little bit in Spanish.
Bastante. Did you ever… Bastante o un poco es lo que es Es lo mismo. Es lo mismo.

Let's talk a little talk. Yeah. Tell me, did you, in those days, ever play any band concerts? Yes. They had band concerts in the park and so on. Did you play in those? Yes. Were they the same musicians who played in the band concerts as played in the music? No.

No, no, no, no, no, no, no. In the French opera, did they have a pretty good, a large orchestra, about 50 pieces? Oh, about that. A big orchestra. Big orchestra. Did you ever study with any of the musicians, take lessons from any of those musicians? No, they had me in the band, rolling my clarinet, all night. In the French opera? At the French opera. You did? Oh, they had me, oh me? Oh no. I've been all through that. You see this? I can take that instrument, I can go in the jazz band, I can go in any band, I can go to the French opera and play with any band, so long they put it in front of me. As long as the music's up there, you can. Just put it in front of me and I got you. Is your clarinet the same, fingering is the same keys as your drum? Yeah, yeah. Same thing you got.
